description: Check that a content page links to at least one commercial page of its own site from its body, and optionally that it states a concrete figure. Links inside excluded boilerplate do not count, because a site-wide call-to-action block would otherwise satisfy this on every page and the check would guard nothing. Relative links count; an absolute link counts only when its host is in site_hosts (or a subdomain of one), so a link to another site's /pricing/ page never does. The money path is matched against the link's path, not its query string.

exclude_classes.description: Classes whose subtree is ignored. Use this for site-wide call-to-action blocks, otherwise they satisfy the check on every page.

extra_evidence.description: Literal strings that satisfy require_figure on their own, such as named product modules.

money_paths.description: Path prefixes that count as commercial, e.g. ["/pricing/","/services/"].

require_figure.description: Also require a concrete price or quantity in the body. "Contact us for a quote" is not an offer.

scope.description: Element to look inside, as [tag, class], e.g. ["article","post"]. Omit to read the whole document.

site_hosts.description: Hosts that are this site, e.g. ["www.example.org"]; subdomains included. Without it, absolute http(s) links never count as internal.

name: check_internal_links
